verses.he: טֽוֹב־רָ֭שׁ הוֹלֵ֣ךְ בְּתֻמּ֑וֹ מֵעִקֵּ֥שׁ שְׂ֝פָתָ֗יו וְה֣וּא כְסִֽיל׃
verses.en: Better is the poor that walketh in his integrity Than he that is perverse in his lips and a fool at the same time.

verses.he: גַּ֤ם בְּלֹא־דַ֣עַת נֶ֣פֶשׁ לֹא־ט֑וֹב וְאָ֖ץ בְּרַגְלַ֣יִם חוֹטֵֽא׃
verses.en: Also, that the soul be without knowledge is not good; And he that hasteth with his feet sinneth.

verses.he: אִוֶּ֣לֶת אָ֭דָם תְּסַלֵּ֣ף דַּרְכּ֑וֹ וְעַל־יְ֝הוָ֗ה יִזְעַ֥ף לִבּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: The foolishness of man perverteth his way; And his heart fretteth against the LORD.

verses.he: ה֗וֹן יֹ֭סִיף רֵעִ֣ים רַבִּ֑ים וְ֝דָ֗ל מֵרֵ֥עהוּ יִפָּרֵֽד׃
verses.en: Wealth addeth many friends; But as for the poor, his friend separateth himself from him.

verses.he: עֵ֣ד שְׁ֭קָרִים לֹ֣א יִנָּקֶ֑ה וְיָפִ֥יחַ כְּ֝זָבִ֗ים לֹ֣א יִמָּלֵֽט׃
verses.en: A false witness shall not be unpunished; And he that breatheth forth lies shall not escape.

verses.he: רַ֭בִּים יְחַלּ֣וּ פְנֵֽי־נָדִ֑יב וְכָל־הָ֝רֵ֗עַ לְאִ֣ישׁ מַתָּֽן׃
verses.en: Many will entreat the favour of the liberal man; And every man is a friend to him that giveth gifts.

verses.he: כָּ֥ל אֲחֵי־רָ֨שׁ׀ שְֽׂנֵאֻ֗הוּ אַ֤ף כִּ֣י מְ֭רֵעֵהוּ רָחֲק֣וּ מִמֶּ֑נּוּ מְרַדֵּ֖ף אֲמָרִ֣ים לא [לוֹ]־הֵֽמָּה׃
verses.en: All the brethren of the poor do hate him; How much more do his friends go far from him! He that pursueth words, they turn against him.

verses.he: קֹֽנֶה־לֵּ֭ב אֹהֵ֣ב נַפְשׁ֑וֹ שֹׁמֵ֥ר תְּ֝בוּנָ֗ה לִמְצֹא־טֽוֹב׃
verses.en: He that getteth wisdom loveth his own soul; He that keepeth understanding shall find good.

verses.he: עֵ֣ד שְׁ֭קָרִים לֹ֣א יִנָּקֶ֑ה וְיָפִ֖יחַ כְּזָבִ֣ים יֹאבֵֽד׃
verses.en: A false witness shall not be unpunished; And he that breatheth forth lies shall perish.

verses.he: לֹֽא־נָאוֶ֣ה לִכְסִ֣יל תַּעֲנ֑וּג אַ֝֗ף כִּֽי־לְעֶ֤בֶד׀ מְשֹׁ֬ל בְּשָׂרִֽים׃
verses.en: Luxury is not seemly for a fool; Much less for a servant to have rule over princes.

verses.he: שֵׂ֣כֶל אָ֭דָם הֶאֱרִ֣יךְ אַפּ֑וֹ וְ֝תִפאַרְתּ֗וֹ עֲבֹ֣ר עַל־פָּֽשַׁע׃
verses.en: It is the discretion of a man to be slow to anger, And it is his glory to pass over a transgression.

verses.he: נַ֣הַם כַּ֭כְּפִיר זַ֣עַף מֶ֑לֶךְ וּכְטַ֖ל עַל־עֵ֣שֶׂב רְצוֹנֽוֹ׃
verses.en: The king’s wrath is as the roaring of a lion; But his favour is as dew upon the grass.

verses.he: הַוֹּ֣ת לְ֭אָבִיו בֵּ֣ן כְּסִ֑יל וְדֶ֥לֶף טֹ֝רֵ֗ד מִדְיְנֵ֥י אִשָּֽׁה׃
verses.en: A foolish son is the calamity of his father; And the contentions of a wife are a continual dropping.

verses.he: בַּ֣יִת וָ֭הוֹן נַחֲלַ֣ת אָב֑וֹת וּ֝מֵיְהוָ֗ה אִשָּׁ֥ה מַשְׂכָּֽלֶת׃
verses.en: House and riches are the inheritance of fathers; But a prudent wife is from the LORD.

verses.he: עַ֭צְלָה תַּפִּ֣יל תַּרְדֵּמָ֑ה וְנֶ֖פֶשׁ רְמִיָּ֣ה תִרְעָֽב׃
verses.en: Slothfulness casteth into a deep sleep; And the idle soul shall suffer hunger.

verses.he: שֹׁמֵ֣ר מִ֭צְוָה שֹׁמֵ֣ר נַפְשׁ֑וֹ בּוֹזֵ֖ה דְרָכָ֣יו יומת [יָמֽוּת]׃
verses.en: He that keepeth the commandment keepeth his soul; But he that despiseth His ways shall die.

verses.he: מַלְוֵ֣ה יְ֭הוָה ח֣וֹנֵֽן דָּ֑ל וּ֝גְמֻל֗וֹ יְשַׁלֶּם־לֽוֹ׃
verses.en: He that is gracious unto the poor lendeth unto the LORD; And his good deed will He repay unto him.

verses.he: יַסֵּ֣ר בִּ֭נְךָ כִּי־יֵ֣שׁ תִּקְוָ֑ה וְאֶל־הֲ֝מִית֗וֹ אַל־תִּשָּׂ֥א נַפְשֶֽׁךָ׃
verses.en: Chasten thy son, for there is hope; But set not thy heart on his destruction. .

verses.he: גרל [גְּֽדָל]־חֵ֭מָה נֹ֣שֵׂא עֹ֑נֶשׁ כִּ֥י אִם־תַּ֝צִּ֗יל וְע֣וֹד תּוֹסִֽף׃
verses.en: A man of great wrath shall suffer punishment; For if thou interpose, thou wilt add thereto.

verses.he: שְׁמַ֣ע עֵ֭צָה וְקַבֵּ֣ל מוּסָ֑ר לְ֝מַ֗עַן תֶּחְכַּ֥ם בְּאַחֲרִיתֶֽךָ׃
verses.en: Hear counsel, and receive instruction, That thou mayest be wise in thy latter end.

verses.he: רַבּ֣וֹת מַחֲשָׁב֣וֹת בְּלֶב־אִ֑ישׁ וַעֲצַ֥ת יְ֝הוָ֗ה הִ֣יא תָקֽוּם׃
verses.en: There are many devices in a man’s heart; But the counsel of the LORD, that shall stand.

verses.he: תַּאֲוַ֣ת אָדָ֣ם חַסְדּ֑וֹ וְטֽוֹב־רָ֝שׁ מֵאִ֥ישׁ כָּזָֽב׃
verses.en: The lust of a man is his shame; And a poor man is better than a liar.

verses.he: יִרְאַ֣ת יְהוָ֣ה לְחַיִּ֑ים וְשָׂבֵ֥עַ יָ֝לִ֗ין בַּל־יִפָּ֥קֶד רָֽע׃
verses.en: The fear of the LORD tendeth to life; And he that hath it shall abide satisfied, He shall not be visited with evil.

verses.he: טָ֘מַ֤ן עָצֵ֣ל יָ֭דוֹ בַּצַּלָּ֑חַת גַּם־אֶל־פִּ֝֗יהוּ לֹ֣א יְשִׁיבֶֽנָּה׃
verses.en: The sluggard burieth his hand in the dish, And will not so much as bring it back to his mouth.

verses.he: לֵ֣ץ תַּ֭כֶּה וּפֶ֣תִי יַעְרִ֑ם וְהוֹכִ֥יחַ לְ֝נָב֗וֹן יָבִ֥ין דָּֽעַת׃
verses.en: When thou smitest a scorner, the simple will become prudent; And when one that hath understanding is reproved, he will understand knowledge.

verses.he: מְֽשַׁדֶּד־אָ֭ב יַבְרִ֣יחַ אֵ֑ם בֵּ֝֗ן מֵבִ֥ישׁ וּמַחְפִּֽיר׃
verses.en: A son that dealeth shamefully and reproachfully Will despoil his father, and chase away his mother.

verses.he: חַֽדַל־בְּ֭נִי לִשְׁמֹ֣עַ מוּסָ֑ר לִ֝שְׁג֗וֹת מֵֽאִמְרֵי־דָֽעַת׃
verses.en: Cease, my son, to hear the instruction That causeth to err from the words of knowledge.

verses.he: עֵ֣ד בְּ֭לִיַּעַל יָלִ֣יץ מִשְׁפָּ֑ט וּפִ֥י רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים יְבַלַּע־אָֽוֶן׃
verses.en: An ungodly witness mocketh at right; And the mouth of the wicked devoureth iniquity.

verses.he: נָכ֣וֹנוּ לַלֵּצִ֣ים שְׁפָטִ֑ים וּ֝מַהֲלֻמ֗וֹת לְגֵ֣ו כְּסִילִֽים׃
verses.en: Judgments are prepared for scorners, And stripes for the back of fools.
